entry.title: Webtop 4.1: X11 is dead and what is Selkies, anyway?
entry.summary: We've now switched our Selkies desktop containers to run in Wayland mode by default, if for any reason you want to got back just set -e PIXELFLUXWAYLAND=false as noted in the change log for each container.
